name: Tsuyu Daku Kanojo
source:
One day, when Keita plays with Saya, his old friend, as usual, she accidentally gets a bucket of water over her head. He gets sexually excited to see her drenched body and pushes her over on the bed. "Ok...." They finally have sex.... However, Yukie, their classmate, sees it all. Keita invites her to join them and they enjoy 3P sex....

[From ErogeShop.com]
